Note for a future curator: testers consistently treat 'fine-mesh strainers' as roughly 6.5–8-inch basket models used for purées, sauces, stocks, and sifting; both ATK and Serious Eats explicitly review small strainers (for tea, citrus juice, dusting) as a SEPARATE class with different winners, so a 'small/mini strainer' category would be a legitimate future split if requested.
